## 4. Notable Projects & Active Builds
1. **Simraungadh Civic Portal & App**:
   - Role: Lead Architect & Developer
   - Description: Civic digitization initiative for Simraungadh Municipality. Provides municipal announcements, citizen grievance ticketing, heritage tourism guides, and emergency contacts.
   - Stack: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GeoJSON.

2. **Smart Hostel ERP (Hostel Management System)**:
   - Role: Full-Stack Engineer
   - Description: Multi-tenant cloud hostel management suite with automated room allocation, student biometric check-in, mess meal accounting, and guardian SMS/WhatsApp alerts.
   - Stack: React 19, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS.

3. **Face ID for Mac (Biometric Authenticator)**:
   - Role: Systems & AI Developer
   - Description: Facial recognition authentication tool for macOS that hooks into the Pluggable Authentication Module (PAM) architecture to authenticate `sudo` commands and lock screen via camera biometrics.
   - Stack: Python, OpenCV, CoreML, macOS PAM C-bindings.

4. **PocketOps (DevOps Telemetry System)**:
   - Role: Systems Developer
   - Description: Micro-agent server monitoring system delivering real-time CPU, RAM, disk I/O, and Docker container health metrics over low-latency WebSockets.
   - Stack: Go, WebSockets, Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS.

5. **Portfolio v4 (Obsidian Cybernetic)**:
   - Official URL: https://www.rahul.rest
   - Description: 2026 flagship portfolio featuring a responsive 2-column mobile project grid, live interactive CLI terminal sandbox emulator, audio synthesizer, and Gemini AI assistant.
   - Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion.

6. **Ice & Fire Cafe**:
   - Description: Digital brand showcase and online ordering system for Ice & Fire Cafe in Simraungadh.

7. **ChatBot AI**:
